verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents isolated cloud sandboxes, official Go/Python/TypeScript SDKs plus a raw HTTP API, and a 'claim' operation for creating sandboxes from templates or snapshots, so SDK/API provisioning is clearly a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows provisioning is a single call or that a live environment is ready in seconds. missing for 10: documented startup/cold-start latency, an explicit single-call create example, independent or hands-on corroboration of provisioning speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up an isolated sandbox with one API/SDK call and get a live environment in seconds

citations.quote: A sandbox gives a user's AI agent an isolated cloud computer where it can run code, install software, manage files, and control network access.
If you want to use the SDKs or raw HTTP API, create a team-scoped API key and export it as SANDBOX0_TOKEN.
